acceptanceCriteria: verify.Stable matches the sealed packet code and verdictSha256 for missing-target-blob and corrupt-target-blob.
Partial-clone (promisor) repositories still refuse without fetching, with the current code; TestMapCoreVerbsRefuseAPromisorObjectWithoutFetching passes.
The native envelope test asserts 29/29 exact cells; CEM-V1-367 is closed as resolved in the spec.
body: Found 2026-10-20 by pre-1.0 lanes on origin/main 7d78a56b0 / a148e3a92, Corvint build 695, Darwin arm64, go1.27.3. V1-0595 U2 (commit c7e561b43, CEM-V1-367): REPOSITORY-ENVELOPE cells missing-target-blob and corrupt-target-blob. Both are UNSUPPORTED/stage repository/exit 2, but native verify.Stable emits repository-object-unavailable (V1-0349/CCF-V1-004 gitauth classification) while the packet and interop/cem01-go emit git-diff-failed (PROPOSED-RULES §4 cause provenance), so verdictSha256 differs. A stable-only switch broke cmd/corvint TestMapCoreVerbsRefuseAPromisorObjectWithoutFetching (blob:none clone). Orchestrator decision (delegated, decision 0548): the sealed packet wins. Native follows git-diff-failed for ordinary repositories; repository-object-unavailable stays only where the object is absent because of a promisor/partial-clone filter. Confirmed bug.

title: CEM stable: native verifier gives repository-object-unavailable but the sealed packet and the portable verifier give git-diff-failed for a missing or corrupt changed blob
